"I’ve known some of the people here since the first morning, now I know they have families, they’ve just started their jobs, or they only wanted to work here for a few days and then return home."
His gaze moved toward the medical area.
"That makes me not want to see their names added to the casualty report."
Lian looked at him for a moment, at least from what he showed, Noah seemed to truly value getting to know others.
"Then we’d better help keep fewer names off that report."
"Yeah.
Exactly." The young Frenchman gave a warmer smile.
A while later, Ed stood up and picked up his umbrella.
But just as he was about to place it over his shoulder, his free hand briefly moved toward his side.
It was a quick, unconscious movement, as if he wanted to draw another weapon from that spot, but his hand stopped before reaching it, and he placed the folded umbrella over his shoulder.
Lian noticed the movement.
That habit again.
Ever since their encounter with the Black Vultures, he had noticed that some of Noah’s movements did not fully match the way he used his umbrella.
On the other hand, the young Frenchman’s skill with that weapon was truly impressive, perhaps his fighting style had been formed by combining several different methods.
Such a thing was not unusual among talented Awakened.
Lian put the matter aside.
"Are you going to rest?"
"Probably.
But first, I want to check on a few people in the support section, anyway, you should get some rest too."
"Later."
"That same answer again."
Then he went down from the platform.
Lian watched him leave for a moment, over these two days, Noah had proven that his presence could be useful to the group.
More importantly, working with him had gradually become more natural.
A while later, he also returned to the command building, Rindo was still examining the map, and several new lines had been drawn in the western and northern sections.
"Did you find anything?"
"Maybe." Rindo raised his head, then pointed at one of the routes.
"Several groups of Withered were spotted in different areas since this morning, most of them didn’t attack the humans, they were just moving."
"In which direction?"
Rindo traced the lines with his finger.
"This group moved from north to south, that one moved from west to east."
Then he pointed at the third marker.
"But when I extend their paths, their overall directions start to look similar."
Lian examined the map, the lines started from different points, but many of them gradually moved closer to the same area.
"Do you also have the information about the new cracks?"
"Yeah."
"Add them."
Rindo marked several red locations.
The young Vorhelm examined the map for a few seconds.
Interesting.
Most groups of Withered were not simply following the nearest crack, some had even passed open cracks and continued moving without entering them.
So they’re not just looking for a way back underground.
If this pattern continued, many of their routes would lead toward a common area.
The center and deepest point of the Land Of First Dawn.
Of course, the central area had not been fully mapped yet, but the way the creatures’ paths were coming together could not be ignored.
"When did these movements begin?"
"Most reports came in after the second Judgment."
After the second Judgment...
Had the execution of the sentences changed the Withered’s behavior?
Or had something else happened at the same time as the Judgment?
It was still unclear.
But one thing was clear, the Withered were moving with a purpose.
"Looks like we’ve finally found a route worth investigating."

chapters.title: Chapter 638: A Destination Against Their Will
paragraphs: At that moment, one of the communication officers entered the room.
"Commander, the latest recorded locations of the Chosen Ones are ready."
Alaric walked toward the table.
"Show me."
The man opened a small map, with four names marked on it, two of the Chosen Ones were in more distant areas, but their approximate locations were known.
There were no new reports about the other two.
One of them was Roderick.
Lian fixed his gaze on the name.
He still hasn’t returned?
Even under normal conditions, Roderick’s independent activities were strange, he wasn’t like Kain, who went hunting alone, and acted more like a leader who led groups.
And now, the situation was even worse, the exit was closed, the ground was collapsing, and the Hollow Sun was carrying out a Judgment every day.
Continuing to act without sending even a short report didn’t seem very reasonable.
"Where was his last recorded location?" Rindo asked.
The man pointed to a part of the map.
"Here."
Lian and Rindo looked at the spot at almost the same time.
Roderick had last been recorded near one of the routes leading to the center of the Land Of First Dawn, the same area toward which many of the Withered were moving.
What an interesting coincidence.
Of course, this didn’t prove anything yet.

Roderick might have gone there to explore, or his communication device might have stopped working, but the possible connection between his last location and the movement of the Withered was worth investigating.
"When was his last report?" the young Vorhelm asked.
"Before the situation in the area became completely critical."
He nodded, as several different objectives were now pointing in the same direction.
Investigating the movement of the Withered, understanding the underground structure of the land, and finding out what had happened to Roderick.
If he could find a suitable route, he might be able to gather valuable information about all three things in a single operation.
But it was still too early to head straight for the center.
At that moment, the communication device of one of the officers sounded.
"Commander, a new report from the western observation unit."
"Send it through," Alaric replied.
A man’s voice came from the communication device.
"We’ve been watching a group of about twenty Withered, they’ve been moving for several hours."
"Have they been in any fights?"
"No, they didn’t show any special reaction even when they saw our forces."
This report matched the information Rindo had gathered, but the scout continued.
"Some of them are badly injured, one of them even had a broken leg, but it was dragging itself across the ground with its hands and continuing to move."
"Which direction were they heading?" the commander asked.
"The center of the land."
They looked at the map, and the scout continued.
"When they reached a valley, they all stopped at almost the same time."
"What happened next?"
"They all turned their heads toward the center, even those whose necks were bent at unnatural angles."
Lian narrowed his eyes.
At the same time?
"Some of them fell down, but they got back up and continued moving in the same direction."
"Why would they all choose the same route?" Rindo asked with curiosity.
No one answered, because this was the same question everyone had, they knew that whatever these creatures were, they possessed a relatively high level of intelligence.
After a moment, the scout continued.
"There’s something else, they talk while moving."
"What are they saying?" Lian raised his head.
"Most of the sounds are unclear, but one of them repeated the same sentence several times."
"What sentence?"
There was silence for a few seconds before the answer came.
"We have to go back."
The young Vorhelm looked at the center of the map for a moment.
Go back?
That word caught his attention, returning usually meant moving to a place where someone had been before.
Perhaps the Withered was only repeating a phrase from its damaged memories, but it was also possible that their destination was a place they had known in the past.
However, the most logical possibility was that they were looking for a way to escape the Hollow Sun’s Judgment.
"There’s one more thing, Commander, something about their movements," the scout spoke again.
"Go on."
"It seems like they don’t want to go in that direction."
Silence fell over the room for a moment.
"What do you mean?" Rindo frowned.
"Some of them cry while moving, several keep shaking their heads, and one of them even tried to change direction several times."
"What happened next?" Lian asked.
The scout took a short breath.
"Every time it left the route, it stopped for a few seconds, then turned its body toward the center again and continued moving."
He paused.
"One of them even threw itself onto the ground and grabbed the dirt with its hands, as if it was trying to stop itself from moving."
A heavy silence filled the room, and then the scout’s final words came through.
"It looks like they want to escape... but they can’t choose not to go."
Lian remained motionless for several seconds, his gaze fixed on the routes that converged on the map, until now, the Withered had seemed like mutated creatures that had suffered severe damage.
Some had lost their minds, while others couldn’t even control their own bodies.
But now, large numbers of them were moving toward the same point against their own will.
Control over their will? Or perhaps some kind of instinctive reaction to the structure of the land?
He still didn’t know, but he couldn’t ignore this matter.
If there was a way to stop that sun and escape this cursed land, the answer was definitely hidden within the Withered.
He moved closer to the map and traced the converging routes with his finger.
Then his gaze stopped on a small point.
Roderick’s last recorded location was near that same area, and for a few moments, Lian simply stared at the mark.
"Tomorrow, we need to find a route toward the center," he said to Rindo.
"We still don’t know what’s happening there." His friend glanced at him.
Lian nodded.
"I know, that’s why I don’t want to enter the center directly, we’ll investigate the nearby routes first, and if we find enough information, we’ll decide what to do next."
Rindo thought for a moment.
"Then we should compare the reports from the southern and western routes, maybe we can find a path that stays away from the large cracks."
"Good."
"Before you leave, bring me the route plan for approval, I don’t want you entering an unknown area without communication support," Alaric said after hearing their decision.
"No problem, but I’d prefer it if only the two of us went, if something happens, it’ll be easier for me to carry one person and fly away," Lian replied.
He now had several reasons to make this trip.
Understanding the cause of the changes in the ground, finding a Withered that might still have some of its memories, and investigating the area near Roderick’s last recorded location.
But most importantly, he wanted to understand what had happened at the center of the Land Of First Dawn that had caused creatures with shattered minds to move toward it against their own will.
Lian fixed his gaze on the center of the map one last time.
Far away, beyond the golden forests and the plains that were splitting apart more with every passing hour, other groups of Withered were still moving.
Some walked on their long, distorted legs, while others dragged their bodies across the rocks.
And some continued moving with broken limbs, making unclear sounds from their throats.
They were heading toward an area that none of the humans currently present had fully mapped.
But one question still remained in Lian’s mind.
What could force creatures that were even afraid to move to return to a specific place?
He still didn’t know the answer.
But he had decided to find it.
Perhaps this answer would also reveal a way for them to escape this land

chapters.title: Chapter 639: A Way Out?
paragraphs: On the morning of the third day in the Land of First Dawn, an unusual calm covered the central base.
Of course, this calm had nothing to do with safety.
Far beyond the defensive walls, columns of steam rose from cracks in the ground, and every few minutes, the sound of breaking rocks spread across the plains.
Some parts of the golden forests, which had looked almost dreamlike two days ago, were now tilted because the ground had sunk beneath them.
However, the forces of the Awakened Association were no longer as frightened as they had been on the first day.

Alaric’s orders had given everyone a clear duty, the support teams were busy moving supplies, the scouts were recording changes in the ground, and the combat forces were stationed at the remaining positions.
Inside one of the rooms in the command building, Lian stood beside the map table.
Rindo stood across from him and used a thin pencil to mark the proposed route for today’s mission on the map.
"If we move along the southwestern route, we can avoid two large cracks, then we’ll enter this area, where we’ve received more reports about the Withered."
The young Vorhelm looked at the lines on the map.
"What about our connection to the base?"
"No problems up to this point, but after that, the height of the ground and the stone walls might weaken our communication signal."
Rindo pointed to a spot near the center.
"I suggest we don’t go any further than this unless the route is truly safe."
Lian nodded.

He planned to use this mission to investigate the Withered’s movements and the areas near the center, perhaps he could find a clue about the cause of the changes in the ground or even discover some information about the sun.
But just as he was about to put the map away, Rindo brought up another matter.
"Lian, I have a question."
"Ask."
He paused for a moment.
"That ability you gained after the incident with the twenty-five thousand victims... the one that should allow you to leave the Ruined Realm and return again."
Lian raised his head.
"What about it?" This ability was no secret, and everyone knew that if someone managed to survive the Sacrifice Event, they could obtain it.
"Have you tried using it to leave this place?"
He remained silent for a moment.
The memory of what had happened the previous night returned to his mind, when he had stood beside Noah on the watchtower and decided to test his exit ability.
The familiar system window had appeared, but contrary to his expectations, after he selected the exit option, he had received several messages in a row.
[ Exit Permission Denied ]
[ Exit Permission Denied ]
[ Leaving the Domain Of The Condemned is impossible without being cleared of all charges ]
He still clearly remembered that after seeing the message, he had tried several more times.
But the result had remained the same.
"Yeah, I tried, but it didn’t work." He looked back at Rindo.
His friend frowned.
"Even with that ability?
"Even with that, apparently this area has a special restriction that even the system can’t ignore."
"What restriction?"
Lian thought about the words in the message for a moment.
"It says that leaving the Domain of the Condemned is impossible without being cleared of all charges."
"The Domain of the Condemned?" Rindo took his hand away from the map.
"Yeah."
"I’ve never heard of an area with that name."
Lian shrugged.
"Neither had I, but now that I think about it, the Hollow Sun also mentioned this place when it condemned Amélie."
Rindo looked at him for a few seconds before speaking slowly.
"Then the Land of First Dawn might not be the real name of this place."
"That’s likely, humans chose this name after discovering the area. We don’t know what it was called before that."
Lian examined the map again.
The Domain of the Condemned.
This name sounded more like a prison than a land where ancient treasures were supposed to be hidden.
On the other hand, the phrase "cleared of all charges" raised even more questions, he didn’t even know exactly what crime he had been accused of.
Did everyone who entered this area become condemned from the moment they arrived?
Or did the sun have to announce their charges first? And more importantly, if someone was condemned, was there even a way to clear their name?
Lian let out a short sigh.
’What a ridiculous justice system, I don’t even know what I’m accused of, but I’m not allowed to leave either.’ He was also curious about who had built this place and why.
"So you think we have to get permission from the sun to leave?" Rindo asked, still lost in thought.
"I don’t know. But I’d rather find another way." Lian paused for a moment before another idea came to mind.
"Rindo, do you think finding a key could help us leave this place?"
His friend looked at him in surprise.
"A key? You mean a key to leave the Ruined Realm?"
The young Vorhelm nodded.
"Exactly."
In the Ruined Realm, every area had a hidden key inside it, a key that could allow someone to leave the area without needing to find a portal or a normal exit route.
Lian knew this very well.
The first time he had been summoned to the Ruined Realm against his will as one of the twenty-five thousand victims, he had eventually managed to escape by using a key he had obtained from Dreadmaw.
That experience was still one of the most dangerous events of his life, and now, perhaps the same method could work again.
His friend looked at the map for a moment.
"If every area really has a key, then there should be one here too."
"That’s what I think."
"But what if the sun’s restriction affects the key too?"
"Then at least we’ll know that another method doesn’t work either." Lian gave a faint smile.
Rindo sighed.
"That sounds very promising."
"Hey, we still have plenty of ways to try."
"Like what?"
"I’m still working on the general idea for now." Lian thought for a moment.
Rindo gave him a tired look, but after a few seconds, the corner of his mouth lifted slightly.
"Fine. If we find anything that looks like a key or something related to leaving, we’ll investigate it."
"Good."
He knew that the chances of finding a key during a short mission were very low.
But now that even his special exit ability didn’t work, he couldn’t ignore any possible way out.
Some time later, after receiving Alaric’s approval, Lian and Rindo left the base.
Before they left, the commander had stressed that they had to report their positions at regular intervals and stop moving forward if they noticed any serious ground instability.
Lian had no problem with these conditions, at least as long as nothing unexpected happened.
The southwestern route passed through plains where some of the golden plants were still intact. However, the farther they moved from the base, the more damage they saw.
Several huge trees had been pulled out of the ground by their roots.
The small springs beside the route had dried up, and in some places, the ground had split open so deeply that thick white roots beneath it were clearly visible.
He stopped in one of these areas.
His gaze fell on a group of roots sticking out from the wall of a crack.
[ True Sequence ]
After he activated the skill, the mana flows became visible to his perception.
The roots still contained a considerable amount of energy, but the direction in which part of it was moving was different from what he had seen on the first day.
Instead of moving toward the surface, the energy was flowing downward along the roots, into depths that even Lian’s current perception couldn’t examine.
Rindo approached him.
"Did you find something?"
Lian pointed at the roots.
"Their mana flow is still moving downward."
"Like what you told me about the Judgment yesterday?"
"That’s right."
He moved his hand away from the roots.
"Record its location for now."
Rindo entered the area’s approximate coordinates into the mapping device, and then they both continued moving.
About an hour later, they spotted their first group of Withered.
There were nearly twelve creatures, slowly moving toward the center of the land along a rocky path.
Some had long, unnatural limbs, while others had changed shape so much that it seemed impossible to identify their original races.
But most of them showed no reaction even after seeing the two Awakened, and simply continued moving.

"If every area really has a key, then there should be one here too."
"That’s what I think."
"But what if the sun’s restriction affects the key too?"
"Then at least we’ll know that another method doesn’t work either." Lian gave a faint smile.
Rindo sighed.
"That sounds very promising."
"Hey, we still have plenty of ways to try."
"Like what?"
"I’m still working on the general idea for now." Lian thought for a moment.
Rindo gave him a tired look, but after a few seconds, the corner of his mouth lifted slightly.
"Fine.
If we find anything that looks like a key or something related to leaving, we’ll investigate it."
"Good."
He knew that the chances of finding a key during a short mission were very low.
But now that even his special exit ability didn’t work, he couldn’t ignore any possible way out.
Some time later, after receiving Alaric’s approval, Lian and Rindo left the base.
Before they left, the commander had stressed that they had to report their positions at regular intervals and stop moving forward if they noticed any serious ground instability.
Lian had no problem with these conditions, at least as long as nothing unexpected happened.
The southwestern route passed through plains where some of the golden plants were still intact.
However, the farther they moved from the base, the more damage they saw.
Several huge trees had been pulled out of the ground by their roots.
The small springs beside the route had dried up, and in some places, the ground had split open so deeply that thick white roots beneath it were clearly visible.
He stopped in one of these areas.
His gaze fell on a group of roots sticking out from the wall of a crack.
[ True Sequence ]
After he activated the skill, the mana flows became visible to his perception.
The roots still contained a considerable amount of energy, but the direction in which part of it was moving was different from what he had seen on the first day.
Instead of moving toward the surface, the energy was flowing downward along the roots, into depths that even Lian’s current perception couldn’t examine.
Rindo approached him.
"Did you find something?"
Lian pointed at the roots.
"Their mana flow is still moving downward."
"Like what you told me about the Judgment yesterday?"
"That’s right."
He moved his hand away from the roots.
"Record its location for now."
Rindo entered the area’s approximate coordinates into the mapping device, and then they both continued moving.
About an hour later, they spotted their first group of Withered.
There were nearly twelve creatures, slowly moving toward the center of the land along a rocky path.
Some had long, unnatural limbs, while others had changed shape so much that it seemed impossible to identify their original races.
But most of them showed no reaction even after seeing the two Awakened, and simply continued moving.

chapters.title: Chapter 640: The Ten Star Spear
paragraphs: Lian watched one of the creatures, a thin Withered with uneven legs, take several steps toward the center.
Then it stopped.
It placed its hands on the ground and tried to turn its body in the opposite direction, but after struggling for a few seconds, it turned back toward the center.
Exactly what the scout had reported.
He was about to move closer and examine the creature’s behavior, but at that very moment, three Withered separated from the group.
Unlike the others, these three creatures showed signs of aggression, and the first one rushed toward them on four long limbs.
The other two also approached from both sides of the path.
Rindo pulled his spear from his back.
"Leave these to me."
"Are you sure?" Lian looked at him for a moment.
"Yeah. You can examine the others too, and see if you can learn anything from their behavior." Rindo held the spear in front of his body.
The young Vorhelm gave a faint smile and walked toward the remaining Withered.
[ Race: The Withered ]
[ Rank: Mutated ]
[ Level: 29 ]
[ Level: 31
[ Level: 33 ]
Lian raised an eyebrow.
Level thirty-three, huh?
Rindo was now level twenty-eight.
Based on the abilities Lian had seen from him, defeating a level-thirty-three monster in a one-on-one fight was possible for him, but it certainly wouldn’t be easy.
And now, three creatures were attacking him at the same time.
However, Rindo didn’t seem particularly worried, he slightly turned his spear.
The weapon’s shaft was made of black and silver metal, and its long, narrow blade shone under the golden sunlight.
But what caught Lian’s attention were the ten small marks carved along the shaft.
He had seen these marks several times before, but he had never had the chance to examine them closely.
What an interesting spear.
The first Withered reached a distance of ten meters, its body was nearly two and a half meters tall, and its right arm had turned into a heavy, bone-like structure.
The creature pulled its arm back and then slammed it toward Rindo with all its strength.
He made no attempt to block the attack directly, his left foot moved slightly backward as he lowered the tip of his spear, and mana flowed along the weapon’s shaft.
One of the ten marks lit up with a faint blue light.
[ Ten Forms of the Heavenly Spear ]
[ First Form: Stillpoint ]
A moment before the impact, Rindo turned his spear with a short movement, and the blade touched the side of the creature’s bony arm.
But instead of stopping the attack, he changed its direction.
BAM!
The creature’s heavy arm slammed into the ground, sending dirt and pieces of stone flying in every direction, but Rindo had only moved half a step.
He had used his opponent’s strength against itself, the Withered tried to pull its arm back up, but Rindo moved before it could do so.
The second mark on the spear lit up.
[ Second Form: Piercing Meridian ]
The silver blade moved straight forward, unlike the previous attack, this time all the mana was focused on the tip of the spear.
The attack struck a narrow gap between the defensive layers on the creature’s chest.
CRACK!
The spearhead pierced the Withered’s body, the creature let out a harsh scream and bent backward.
But Rindo had no time to continue his attack, the level-thirty-one Withered had approached quickly from the left.
Its long claws moved straight toward Rindo’s neck, he pulled his spear back and struck the creature’s wrist with the end of the shaft.
The direction of the claws changed.
However, the third creature, which was level thirty-three, took advantage of the opening and quickly approached from the right, throwing a heavy strike at Rindo’s side.
Rindo was forced to jump backward, and the creature’s claw passed in front of his stomach, tearing part of his armor.
If he had reacted even a fraction of a second later, the attack would probably have seriously injured him.
Instead of trying to defeat all three creatures quickly, he changed his position to force the attackers to approach from the same direction.
The level-twenty-nine Withered, which had been injured by the previous attack, was the first to attack again.
He aimed his spear at it, but just before the strike landed, he changed the direction of the blade.
The third mark on the shaft lit up.
[ Third Form: Threefold Return ]
Three consecutive movements followed.
The first strike knocked aside the level-thirty-one Withered’s arm.
The second strike hit the level-thirty-three creature in the side and forced it to change the direction of its attack.
And the third strike hit the exact same spot that the second form had created in the chest of the level-twenty-nine Withered.
The blade passed through the gap in its defenses, and a few moments later, the creature’s body fell motionless to the ground.
Rindo pulled out his spear, but two enemies still remained.
The level-thirty-one Withered attacked with a harsh scream.
He stepped toward it this time, and the end of his spear struck the creature’s knee, throwing it off balance.
Then, by turning the shaft, he sent the blade toward its neck from a lower angle, dark blood splashed across the stones, and the second creature fell as well.
However At that exact moment, the Level 33 Withered reached him.
Unlike the previous two enemies, this creature had watched Rindo’s movements and no longer attacked the blade directly.
This time, it approached from the side and tried to close the distance, where using a long spear would be more difficult.
Rindo was forced to pull his weapon back.
The creature’s next strike hit the shaft of his spear, and a heavy force passed through his hands.
He took several steps back.
This one was really better than the others.
The creature attacked again.
Rindo used the First Form to redirect the attack, but the force caused his foot to slip on the stone.
He quickly regained his balance and sent more mana into his spear.
With a spinning movement, he placed the shaft of his weapon between himself and the creature, and when the Withered moved forward to break his defense, he sent the spear’s tip upward into its body.
The strike pierced the creature’s side, but despite the injury, the Withered wrapped its hand around the shaft of the weapon instead of retreating.
Rindo frowned.
If he wanted to pull the spear out directly, he would have to use a lot of strength, and if he took too long, the creature’s other hand would reach him.
So instead of pulling the spear, he took a step forward, changed his body’s position, turned the shaft at a different angle, and forced the creature’s hand to move along with the weapon.

Then he raised the end of the spear, and the shaft struck the Withered’s jaw, throwing its head backward, and at that same moment, the spear’s blade came out of its side with a short movement and returned toward its neck.
Slash!
This time, the strike was deadly, the creature’s body took several unsteady steps and finally fell to the ground.
Rindo took a deep breath.
A few drops of sweat ran down the side of his face, and the mana flowing around his spear slowly faded.
He looked at the bodies for a few seconds.
Then he lowered his blade.
"It’s over."
Lian had also finished examining the other Withered a while ago.
"I have to admit, your spear is more interesting than I thought."
"Just the spear?" Rindo looked at him.
"Fine, your skills aren’t bad either."
"Thank you very much."
Lian pointed at the ten marks on the body of the weapon.
"So each of these belongs to a different form?"
"Yeah. The Ten Star Spear was made to perform this martial art."
Rindo ran his finger over one of the dark marks.
"But the weapon alone isn’t enough, if the order of body movements and mana flow isn’t correct, even the best spear can’t perform that form."
Lian nodded.
Through [True Sequence], he had also noticed that Rindo did not completely stop the flow of mana when changing forms.
Part of the energy and position gained from one movement was used to perform the next movement.
This gave his martial art a connected structure.
"So there are still seven forms left."
Rindo nodded.
"Yeah."
"I hope I get the chance to see all of them someday." Lian smiled.
"Maybe, but I’d rather not be forced to use all ten forms just to stay alive."
"That’s a reasonable choice."
Lian turned his gaze toward the bodies.
Despite his victory, Rindo had used some of his mana, and his breathing had not completely returned to normal.
Even so, his performance was impressive.

chapters.title: Chapter 641: Fried Withered
paragraphs: He was only Level 28, and defeating three creatures up to Level 33 without direct help showed that his martial art and experience were truly valuable.
Of course, the difference in their strength was still huge, Lian could easily kill even Level 45 monsters.
But he was an anomaly, not a normal standard, and no one should use common sense to compare him with others.
After a short rest, they both continued moving.
The closer they got to the paths leading toward the center, the more Withered they encountered.
But the strange thing was that many of them still paid no attention to humans.
Creatures with broken bodies, missing legs, and twisted faces continued moving without stopping.
Some did not even turn their heads toward Lian and Rindo when passing beside them, as if their destination was more important than anything else.
Near noon, Rindo’s communication device activated.
"Southwest scouting team to all nearby forces, we need immediate help!"
He answered immediately.
"Report."
"There are four of us! Our escape route is blocked, and several mutated creatures are attacking us!"
Lian looked at Rindo.
His friend checked the reported location.
"They’re about two kilometers from here."
"Then let’s go."
Before Rindo could even lower his communication device, Lian started moving.
His body moved quickly through the trees, and his friend was forced to send more mana into his legs to keep the distance between them from becoming too large.
A few minutes later, the sounds of metal clashing and creatures roaring reached their ears, and they arrived at a rocky area with a deep crack on one side.
Four Awakened had taken positions near a broken wall.
One of them was injured, and two others were using their weapons to keep several attacking Withered away.
But there were more than just a few creatures around the area.
Lian quickly estimated their number with a glance.
Nearly thirty Withered.
Some were moving toward the center and paid no attention to the battle, but another group was acting very aggressively.
One of them, a creature nearly four meters tall, attacked the defenders with its bone claws.
Rindo immediately prepared his spear, but Lian raised his hand.
"It’s my turn this time." He didn’t want to waste too much time here, the Third Judgment was getting closer, and time was very valuable in this situation.
Rindo looked at the creatures.
Several information windows had appeared in front of him.
[Level 38]
[Level 42]
And even [Level 46]
He did not lower his spear, but he stopped moving forward.
"Alright, I’ll protect the trapped forces."
"Good." Lian nodded and then walked toward the battlefield.
A Level 34 Withered noticed his presence and ran toward him with a rough roar.
He didn’t even change the speed of his steps, when the creature came within a few meters, he lowered his palm slightly.
[Frost Dominion]
Intense cold spread across the ground.
The moisture in the air turned into tiny ice crystals, and a layer of ice formed over the stones, cracks in the ground, and the attackers’ feet.
Several Withered tried to change direction, but before they could succeed, the ice around their limbs became thicker.
The Level 34 creature pulled its foot from the ground with all its strength.
Part of the ice broke.
But just as it was about to take its second step, Lian appeared in front of it.
The creature opened its mouth, but it had no chance to make a sound.
His right fist struck its face.
BOOOOM!
The Withered’s head was destroyed by the strike, and its headless body remained standing for a few moments before falling onto the frozen ground.
[You have killed a Level 34 Withered]
Lian turned his gaze toward the others.
"Next."
A Level 40 Withered with thick arms broke the ice around its feet and charged forward.
But before it could reach the young Vorhelm, another strike hit its chest, and the sound of breaking bones could be heard.
The creature’s body bent backward and fell to the ground.
Lian had not even used a special skill, for most of these creatures, his normal physical strength was more than enough.
[You have killed a Level 40 Withered]
[EXP Gained]
At the same time, three Withered moved toward the four trapped Awakened from the eastern side of the battlefield.
Rindo stepped forward and prepared his spear, but one of the creatures was Level 42, and it had already gotten very close to the injured forces.
Lian glanced in that direction and then raised his right hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
Cold mana formed in front of his hand, and five huge, curved blades made of solid ice appeared; their edges were so thin that the golden sunlight reflected on them as bright lines.
With a movement of his hand, the claw moved across the battlefield, the first Withered tried to jump backward, but it was too late...
The ice blades passed through its body.
The second creature raised its arms, but the huge claw cut through them and continued moving, tearing open its chest.
The third Withered managed to move beside a large rock.
But Lian changed the direction of his attack.
The ice claw returned from the opposite angle and cut the creature’s body in half before it could escape.
All of this had happened in just a few seconds.
Rindo stopped moving for a moment, then turned his gaze from the bodies toward Lian.
This isn’t fair at all.
He had been forced to change his position several times and use a considerable amount of mana to defeat three weaker Withered.
But Lian had destroyed stronger creatures without even getting close to them.
Of course, this did not make him jealous.
Instead, seeing such a huge difference in strength helped him better understand how far he still was from the greatest talent and genius of his generation.
And more importantly, he still had plenty of time to improve.
At that moment, a loud roar came from the direction of the crack.
A Level 46 Withered with a long body and several bone arms came out from between the rocks.
Unlike most of the creatures around it, its movements were fast and well-coordinated.
Several of its long arms had turned into bone blades, and every time it moved, their tips left deep marks on the stone surface.
The creature examined the battlefield, its gaze stopped on the frozen bodies, and then it stared at Lian.
For a moment, it remained still, it had enough intelligence to understand that it was not facing an ordinary human, but a top predator.
A predator created to hunt monsters, the ultimate nightmare.
Even so, it did not have enough common sense to run away, and instead, it attacked at high speed.
Lian looked at the creature.
The Withered jumped from the frozen ground and twisted its body in the air, four bone blades moved toward him from different angles at the same time.
But he did not even take a step back, and mana began flowing around his body.
[Thunder Calamity]
A loud sound of thunder filled the battlefield, and streams of dark, bright lightning formed around the young Vorhelm’s arm.
Before the bone blades could reach him, the lightning crossed the short distance between them.
CRAAACK!
The Withered’s body tightened in the air, and several of its arms moved away from their attack paths without control, stopping its fast movement for a moment.
Lian tilted his head slightly.
"Did you really think you could reach me?"
Despite its injuries, the creature tried to regain control of its body.
But he raised his hand, and another stream of lightning gathered along his arm, and a moment later...KRAAAACK!
The lightning struck the Withered’s chest, the smell of burned flesh spread through the air, and the creature’s body was thrown backward before falling among the broken rocks several meters away.
This time, it did not get up again, naturally, after turning from a Withered into a fried Withered, there was no way it was getting back up.
[You have killed a Level 46 Withered]
[EXP Gained]
One of the trapped Awakened stared at the scene with his mouth half-open.
"Is he... is he really a student?"
His companion did not answer, because he himself did not know what to say.
They even felt a little sorry for the Withered, they had been fried in just a few seconds.
Without paying attention to their reactions, Lian moved toward another Withered.
The Level 43 creature, unlike the previous enemies, had formed layers of dense mana around its body.
When he approached it, the Withered raised its thick arms, and the defensive structure around its chest became stronger.
He examined the mana flow for a moment and then gave a faint smile.
The golden light around his right fist turned dark for a moment.
[Corrupt Sun]
Eclipse Energy moved along the same corrupted light and settled on one of the creature’s defensive layers.
The Withered noticed the change and tried to send more mana to that same point.
But the young Vorhelm moved before the monster could complete its defense, and his fist struck the creature’s chest.
At that same moment, the damaged mana layer began to weaken under the effect of the corrupted light, and a small amount of End Energy also reached that same point.
The connection within the damaged section broke for a moment, and the physical force of Lian’s fist passed through the opening.
CRACK!
The sound of the Withered’s internal structures breaking could be heard.
The creature remained still for a moment, then fell to its knees before its body collapsed forward.
[You have killed a Level 43 Withered]
[EXP Gained]

But before it could reach the young Vorhelm, another strike hit its chest, and the sound of breaking bones could be heard.
The creature’s body bent backward and fell to the ground.
Lian had not even used a special skill, for most of these creatures, his normal physical strength was more than enough.
[You have killed a Level 40 Withered]
[EXP Gained]
At the same time, three Withered moved toward the four trapped Awakened from the eastern side of the battlefield.
Rindo stepped forward and prepared his spear, but one of the creatures was Level 42, and it had already gotten very close to the injured forces.
Lian glanced in that direction and then raised his right hand.
[Glacial Reaper Claw]
Cold mana formed in front of his hand, and five huge, curved blades made of solid ice appeared; their edges were so thin that the golden sunlight reflected on them as bright lines.
With a movement of his hand, the claw moved across the battlefield, the first Withered tried to jump backward, but it was too late...
The ice blades passed through its body.
The second creature raised its arms, but the huge claw cut through them and continued moving, tearing open its chest.
The third Withered managed to move beside a large rock.
But Lian changed the direction of his attack.
The ice claw returned from the opposite angle and cut the creature’s body in half before it could escape.
All of this had happened in just a few seconds.
Rindo stopped moving for a moment, then turned his gaze from the bodies toward Lian.
This isn’t fair at all.
He had been forced to change his position several times and use a considerable amount of mana to defeat three weaker Withered.
But Lian had destroyed stronger creatures without even getting close to them.
Of course, this did not make him jealous.
Instead, seeing such a huge difference in strength helped him better understand how far he still was from the greatest talent and genius of his generation.
And more importantly, he still had plenty of time to improve.
At that moment, a loud roar came from the direction of the crack.
A Level 46 Withered with a long body and several bone arms came out from between the rocks.
Unlike most of the creatures around it, its movements were fast and well-coordinated.
Several of its long arms had turned into bone blades, and every time it moved, their tips left deep marks on the stone surface.
The creature examined the battlefield, its gaze stopped on the frozen bodies, and then it stared at Lian.
For a moment, it remained still, it had enough intelligence to understand that it was not facing an ordinary human, but a top predator.
A predator created to hunt monsters, the ultimate nightmare.
Even so, it did not have enough common sense to run away, and instead, it attacked at high speed.
Lian looked at the creature.
The Withered jumped from the frozen ground and twisted its body in the air, four bone blades moved toward him from different angles at the same time.
But he did not even take a step back, and mana began flowing around his body.
[Thunder Calamity]
A loud sound of thunder filled the battlefield, and streams of dark, bright lightning formed around the young Vorhelm’s arm.
Before the bone blades could reach him, the lightning crossed the short distance between them.
CRAAACK!
The Withered’s body tightened in the air, and several of its arms moved away from their attack paths without control, stopping its fast movement for a moment.
Lian tilted his head slightly.
"Did you really think you could reach me?"
Despite its injuries, the creature tried to regain control of its body.
But he raised his hand, and another stream of lightning gathered along his arm, and a moment later...KRAAAACK!
The lightning struck the Withered’s chest, the smell of burned flesh spread through the air, and the creature’s body was thrown backward before falling among the broken rocks several meters away.
This time, it did not get up again, naturally, after turning from a Withered into a fried Withered, there was no way it was getting back up.
[You have killed a Level 46 Withered]
[EXP Gained]
One of the trapped Awakened stared at the scene with his mouth half-open.
"Is he... is he really a student?"
His companion did not answer, because he himself did not know what to say.
They even felt a little sorry for the Withered, they had been fried in just a few seconds.
Without paying attention to their reactions, Lian moved toward another Withered.
The Level 43 creature, unlike the previous enemies, had formed layers of dense mana around its body.
When he approached it, the Withered raised its thick arms, and the defensive structure around its chest became stronger.
He examined the mana flow for a moment and then gave a faint smile.
The golden light around his right fist turned dark for a moment.
[Corrupt Sun]
Eclipse Energy moved along the same corrupted light and settled on one of the creature’s defensive layers.
The Withered noticed the change and tried to send more mana to that same point.
But the young Vorhelm moved before the monster could complete its defense, and his fist struck the creature’s chest.
At that same moment, the damaged mana layer began to weaken under the effect of the corrupted light, and a small amount of End Energy also reached that same point.
The connection within the damaged section broke for a moment, and the physical force of Lian’s fist passed through the opening.
CRACK!
The sound of the Withered’s internal structures breaking could be heard.
The creature remained still for a moment, then fell to its knees before its body collapsed forward.
[You have killed a Level 43 Withered]
[EXP Gained]

chapters.title: Chapter 642: Disaster Suppression Fist
paragraphs: Lian lowered his hand.
"Good, with much less energy than I would’ve needed to break that defense directly."
At that moment, the sound of breaking stone came from the direction of the main crack.
He turned his head, part of the stone wall moved outward, and then a huge hand appeared from the darkness.
Thick fingers covered in structures that looked like metal and stone grabbed the edge of the crack, and a few moments later, a creature nearly six meters tall climbed up from the depths.
Its body was covered in several layers of natural armor, dark streams of mana moved between those layers, and every heavy step it took crushed the stones beneath its feet.
Its information window appeared.
[Race: The Withered]
[Rank: Mutated]
[Level: 48]
Rindo immediately tightened his grip on his spear, a Level 48 monster!
This was no longer a joke, this was a monster that could even be a threat to a small base in the Ruined Realm.
And now one of them had appeared in front of two students.
"Lian, that one—"
"I see it."
The young Vorhelm answered calmly.
The huge Withered looked around.
Several bodies were lying on the ground, and a large part of the battlefield was covered in ice.
The creature let out a deep roar and then fixed its gaze on him.
For a moment, the streams of mana around its armor became brighter, as if it was strengthening its defense to face the enemy.
Lian noticed this change.
Hmm.
He could defeat this creature with a few normal punches as well.
But since obtaining one of his recent skills, he had not yet found a good chance to test its effect in a real battle.
And now, a relatively tough target was standing in front of him, he slowly clenched his right fist.
[Disaster Suppression Fist]
Mana slowly gathered around his fist.
But unlike skills that released energy into the surroundings, this time, the power was focused in a compressed structure along his fist and arm.
Rindo, who was standing a few meters away, felt the change in mana pressure.
He raised his head without thinking.
What kind of skill is this?
The energy around Lian’s fist was extremely dense, not in a messy way, but with such precise control that most of the power remained in the same place until the moment of impact.
Meanwhile, the huge Withered charged toward Lian with a loud roar, every step crushed the rocky ground beneath it, and the creature raised its right arm.
An arm as thick as a tree trunk, covered in several layers of natural armor...then it brought it down with all its strength.
The young Vorhelm took one step forward, just one step, and threw his fist.
[Disaster Suppression Fist]
BOOOOOOM!
At the moment of impact, a heavy sound filled the battlefield. The layers of armor on the creature’s arm cracked at the same time.
The mana streams moving inside them to strengthen its defense broke apart under the huge pressure of the strike.
But his fist did not stop.
The compressed force passed through the creature’s arm and spread along its shoulder and chest, for a fraction of a second, the Withered’s six-meter-tall body remained completely still.
Then...CRAAAACK!
Deep cracks appeared all across the armor on its chest.
The force of the strike came out through the creature’s back, and a wave of pressure destroyed a huge rock farther away.
The Withered’s body was thrown backward with terrifying force.
It flew several meters through the air and finally crashed into the stone wall of the crack.
BAAANG!
Part of the wall collapsed, and broken rocks fell onto the creature’s body, sending a cloud of dust across the battlefield.
For a few seconds, there was silence.
But Lian was still standing in the same place, he had not lost his balance or even been forced to move his back foot.
His right fist was still held in front of his body.
He looked at his hand for a moment.
He examined the small amount of mana still flowing around it.
Then he opened his fist.
"Not bad."
Rindo stared at him for a few seconds and then looked toward the collapsed wall.
"Not bad?"
"What?" He turned his head.
His friend remained silent for a moment and then sighed.
"Nothing. I just think our definitions of that phrase are a little different."
"Well, there’s still room for improvement." Lian gave a short laugh.
This time, Rindo decided not to answer.
Because he was completely sure that if Lian decided to strengthen that skill even more, the result would not be very pleasant for his future enemies.
That skill was already so powerful that it had knocked out a damn Level 48 monster in a single strike.
At that moment, several system messages appeared in front of Lian.
[EXP Gained]
[EXP Gained]
[Level Up!]
He looked at the system window for a moment.
Finally.
He had reached Level 31.
The EXP gained from his hunts over the past few days and today’s battle had finally been enough to increase his level.
Then he closed the window.
At that moment, one of the rescued Awakened carefully approached.
"...I really don’t know how to thank you."
"There’s no need, how many of you are injured?" Lian looked at the man.
"One of us has serious injuries to his legs, but the rest of us can still move."
"Then you’d better head back right now, the northern path is still open, but there’s no telling how long it’ll stay that way.
Rindo also approached.
"I’ll report your location to the base, if you follow this path, you should be able to reach one of the outer positions."
The man nodded.
"Understood."
After that, the four Awakened slowly left the area.
Lian and Rindo watched their positions until they were sure they had moved away from the dangerous area.
Then they started moving toward the center again, in the afternoon, the sky was still bright with the golden light of the Hollow Sun.
But the land beneath it no longer looked much like it had on the first day.
More trees had been pulled out of the ground, and some of the old paths now ended at deep cracks.
They were passing beside one of these cracks when a weak voice caught their attention.
"D-don’t... come... closer..."
Rindo immediately prepared his spear.
Lian turned his gaze toward the voice.
A little farther away, beside the huge roots of a broken tree, one of the Withered was sitting, the creature was nearly two and a half meters tall.
Its body was thin and covered in white, cracked skin, and one of its eyes was completely gone.
But unlike many of the other Withered, its face still had a somewhat normal shape.
An information window appeared.
[Race: The Withered]
[Rank: Mutated]
[Level: 38]
When the creature saw them, it tried to move backward, but its body was strangely resisting.
Its long hands pressed against the ground, and its legs turned toward the center, in the opposite direction of where it was trying to move.
"D-don’t... come..."
"You can speak?" Lian took a few steps forward.
The Withered raised its head with difficulty, for a moment, its remaining eye socket stayed fixed on him.
"S-still..."
Rindo looked at his friend for a moment.
"This one’s more aware than the others."
Lian nodded, he had noticed the same thing.
"Why are all of you moving toward the center?"
The creature said nothing for several seconds and then looked down at its own legs, wrapping its long fingers around one of them.
"I... don’t... want to..."
"Don’t want to what?" The young Vorhelm narrowed his eyes.
"Go... back..." The Withered answered with difficulty.
"Where?"
The creature began to shake, for a moment, it opened its mouth, but no sound came out, and then it said with difficulty.
"The... center..."
Lian glanced into the distance, the center of this land.
"What’s there?"

chapters.title: Chapter 643: We Were Never Meant to Wake ( PS Bonus - )
paragraphs: The creature placed its hands on its head, and its body shook violently.
Lian waited.
The Withered tried to pull its legs beneath its body for a moment, but its muscles tightened against its will.
It took one step toward the center.
Then a second step.
The creature threw itself onto the ground in fear.
"I don’t want to...!"
Rindo raised his spear without thinking, but Lian made a small gesture, asking him not to interfere for now.
[True Sequence]
The mana streams around the Withered’s body became visible.
He examined them for several seconds, on the surface, the energy inside the creature’s body was extremely unstable.
This was not strange for a mutated creature, but a small part of the streams behaved differently.
Every time the Withered’s body moved toward the center against its will, a weak pulse appeared in some of its mana channels.
A pulse that seemed to match an energy flow beneath the ground.
Interesting.
Lian slowly moved closer.
"I want to try something for a few seconds."
The creature raised its head, but before it could answer, Lian activated a very small amount of [Corrupt Sun].
A thin line of dark light formed beside his hand, and he carefully directed it toward one of the energy channels he had seen around the Withered’s body.
The contact lasted only a moment.
But that was enough.
Part of the mana structure began to break down, the strange pulse stopped, and the Withered’s body stopped moving.
The creature remained still for several seconds, then slowly lowered its head and looked at its own hands.
It moved its long fingers, and this time, the movement followed its own will.
"I... stopped?"
Lian examined the energy flow.
So it really does affect its movements.
But the effect lasted only a few seconds, a new flow of energy entered from the same unknown structure, the damaged path became stable again, and the Withered’s body began moving against its will.
The creature let out a weak, broken cry.
Lian stopped the corrupted light.
He could use more energy, but he still did not know what effect such interference would have on the Withered’s body or soul.
Especially when the main structure was outside the range of his examination.
"So something is controlling them?" Rindo asked quietly.
The young Vorhelm nodded.
"Most likely, but I still don’t know what it is."
Then he looked at the Withered again.
"Is there a prison down there?"
The creature remained still for a moment.
The word prison seemed to cause a reaction in its damaged mind.
"Pri... son..."
Lian waited.
The Withered placed its hand over its face and then continued in a weak voice.
"We... weren’t... supposed to..."
Its body shook.
"Wake... up..."
Rindo looked at Lian, but Lian was still staring at the creature.
They weren’t supposed to wake up? The third charge against Sareven suddenly came back to his mind.
[Disobeying the State of Stillness]
Could it be that the Withered had been in a state similar to sleep or imprisonment before the awakening of the sun?
He still had no evidence to fully confirm this theory, but now, the possibility seemed more reasonable than before.
"Who kept you down there? Was it the Judge?"
The creature tried to answer.
But an unclear sound came from its throat.
A few moments later, it turned its head toward the sky.
"J-Judge..."
Its fingers began to shake.
"Awake... again..."
Then its body suddenly tightened, the Withered stood up from the ground against its own will and began moving toward the center.
This time, Lian did not stop it, he watched the creature’s movements for a few moments and then looked at Rindo.
"I think we’re getting close to some interesting things."
"Interesting? I’d rather call it worrying." Rindo answered with a serious expression.
He gave a faint smile.
"That too."
They both continued moving.
But this time, Lian was not only paying attention to the path of the Withered, he was also watching the mana flows beneath the ground.
And he gradually noticed that the closer they moved toward the center, the more white roots and underground energy structures appeared.
In one area, a deep crack had revealed part of a stone wall.
Unlike the natural rocks around it, the wall had a relatively smooth surface, and several worn marks could be seen on it.
Rindo approached.
"Is this structure natural?"
Lian shook his head.
"I doubt it."
On the stone, an image of a huge ring with an empty center had been carved.
It looked very similar to the Hollow Sun.
Around it were complex lines and ancient writings, most of which had been damaged over time.
The young Vorhelm examined them with [True Sequence].
A very weak amount of mana still remained in some parts of the wall, but most of the energy paths had been broken.
He slowly moved his hand toward one of the marks, among the worn lines, a geometric opening could be seen, a shape that looked more like part of a locking mechanism than a simple decoration.
A key?
For a moment, Lian thought about his conversation with Rindo that morning, of course, there was no reason to believe that this structure was necessarily connected to the exit key.
It could be part of an ancient seal, a defensive mechanism, or even a completely different structure.
"Did you figure anything out?" Rindo asked.
"Not much, but I think we should record its location."
He examined the wall for a few more moments.
On its lower section, several marks remained that seemed to have once been part of a longer writing.
But in their current condition, it was impossible to read them completely.
He finally stepped back.
"Let’s go for now, I don’t want us to still be in this area when it gets darker."
Rindo nodded, and they both continued along their path.
But a few minutes later, they came across signs of a recent battle, several Withered were lying among the rocks.
Some of the bodies were badly damaged, and signs of heavy impacts could be seen around them.
Rindo knelt beside one of them.
"These haven’t been dead for very long."
Lian looked at a broken rock, several impact marks could be seen on it, but what was even stranger was the condition of the bodies.
Some of the Withered had apparently been attacked several more times even after receiving deadly blows.
He looked at one of them for a moment.
What kind of fight was this?
Rindo checked the map.
"Roderick’s last recorded location was near this area."
"I know."
Roderick was one of the powerful Chosen, and his aggressive fighting style could have caused this kind of destruction.
"Do you want to investigate further?" Rindo asked.
Lian looked at the path ahead.
"Not for now, record its location. We’d better get away from the dangerous areas before the next Judgment."
His friend agreed, but just as he was about to close the map, the ground beneath their feet shook.
The shaking was not very strong.
Both of them stopped for a moment.
"Another crack?"
Lian activated [True Sequence], the mana flows beneath the ground shook for a moment, and then the shaking stopped.
"Probably."
He waited for a few more seconds, when nothing else happened, they both started moving again.
But they had not even traveled a few hundred meters when the second shaking began.
This time, it was stronger.
Small stones fell from the edges of the cracks, and one of the golden trees near the path cracked with a loud sound.
Rindo immediately stopped.
"Lian."
Vorhelm also stopped moving and fixed his gaze on the ground.
This one is different.
The mana flows beneath the ground were no longer the same as they had been a few minutes earlier, several paths that had previously been relatively stable had begun changing direction.
And in some places, energy was moving toward the depths at a very high speed.
He raised his head.
But before he could say anything...
CRAAAACK!

"I think we’re getting close to some interesting things."
"Interesting?
I’d rather call it worrying." Rindo answered with a serious expression.
He gave a faint smile.
"That too."
They both continued moving.
But this time, Lian was not only paying attention to the path of the Withered, he was also watching the mana flows beneath the ground.
And he gradually noticed that the closer they moved toward the center, the more white roots and underground energy structures appeared.
In one area, a deep crack had revealed part of a stone wall.
Unlike the natural rocks around it, the wall had a relatively smooth surface, and several worn marks could be seen on it.
Rindo approached.
"Is this structure natural?"
Lian shook his head.
"I doubt it."
On the stone, an image of a huge ring with an empty center had been carved.
It looked very similar to the Hollow Sun.
Around it were complex lines and ancient writings, most of which had been damaged over time.
The young Vorhelm examined them with [True Sequence].
A very weak amount of mana still remained in some parts of the wall, but most of the energy paths had been broken.
He slowly moved his hand toward one of the marks, among the worn lines, a geometric opening could be seen, a shape that looked more like part of a locking mechanism than a simple decoration.
A key?
For a moment, Lian thought about his conversation with Rindo that morning, of course, there was no reason to believe that this structure was necessarily connected to the exit key.
It could be part of an ancient seal, a defensive mechanism, or even a completely different structure.
"Did you figure anything out?" Rindo asked.
"Not much, but I think we should record its location."
He examined the wall for a few more moments.
On its lower section, several marks remained that seemed to have once been part of a longer writing.
But in their current condition, it was impossible to read them completely.
He finally stepped back.
"Let’s go for now, I don’t want us to still be in this area when it gets darker."
Rindo nodded, and they both continued along their path.
But a few minutes later, they came across signs of a recent battle, several Withered were lying among the rocks.
Some of the bodies were badly damaged, and signs of heavy impacts could be seen around them.
Rindo knelt beside one of them.
"These haven’t been dead for very long."
Lian looked at a broken rock, several impact marks could be seen on it, but what was even stranger was the condition of the bodies.
Some of the Withered had apparently been attacked several more times even after receiving deadly blows.
He looked at one of them for a moment.
What kind of fight was this?
Rindo checked the map.
"Roderick’s last recorded location was near this area."
"I know."
Roderick was one of the powerful Chosen, and his aggressive fighting style could have caused this kind of destruction.
"Do you want to investigate further?" Rindo asked.
Lian looked at the path ahead.
"Not for now, record its location.
We’d better get away from the dangerous areas before the next Judgment."
His friend agreed, but just as he was about to close the map, the ground beneath their feet shook.
The shaking was not very strong.
Both of them stopped for a moment.
"Another crack?"
Lian activated [True Sequence], the mana flows beneath the ground shook for a moment, and then the shaking stopped.
"Probably."
He waited for a few more seconds, when nothing else happened, they both started moving again.
But they had not even traveled a few hundred meters when the second shaking began.
This time, it was stronger.
Small stones fell from the edges of the cracks, and one of the golden trees near the path cracked with a loud sound.
Rindo immediately stopped.
"Lian."
Vorhelm also stopped moving and fixed his gaze on the ground.
This one is different.
The mana flows beneath the ground were no longer the same as they had been a few minutes earlier, several paths that had previously been relatively stable had begun changing direction.
And in some places, energy was moving toward the depths at a very high speed.
He raised his head.
But before he could say anything...
CRAAAACK!

chapters.title: Chapter 644: The Third Judgment ( PS Bonus - )
paragraphs: A crack about thirty meters away opened wider with a terrible sound.
The rocky ground around it broke, and several trees fell downward along with their huge roots, while hot steam rose from the depths.
Rindo prepared his spear.
"We need to go back!"
"Yeah." Lian nodded.
But just as they both turned toward their previous path, another breaking sound came from behind them.
This time, it was much closer.
The ground beneath their return path began to separate, and within a few seconds, the narrow crack they had passed that morning turned into a deep valley.
Huge pieces of rock broke away from the edges.
White roots came out of the soil, and several golden trees fell into the crack along with parts of the ground.
Rindo stared at the path in disbelief.
"Damn it..."
But the disaster was not over yet.
The third shaking began.
This time, the ground was shaking continuously, farther away, a large part of the forest began to sink.

The sound of hundreds of tree trunks breaking spread across the plain, and one of the rocky paths that had been completely intact just moments earlier split in half, with part of it disappearing into the depths.
Lian looked at Rindo.
"Come here."
Two huge black wings opened behind his back.
[Wings of God]
He grabbed Rindo’s arm and lifted off the ground with a single movement.
At that same moment, the rocky ground beneath their feet broke, and several huge pieces fell from the exact place where they had been standing.
With a movement of his wings, he gained altitude and flew toward a higher rock while carrying Rindo.
But when he saw the condition of the area from above, his expression became more serious for a moment.
Oh...
The cracks had not expanded in just one place, new cracks had appeared all across the plain.
Some of them had become several times wider than before, and in some areas, huge pieces of land were separating from each other.
Even paths that had looked completely stable that morning had now disappeared.
Rindo, who was still holding Lian’s arm, looked behind them.
"The way back..."
The young Vorhelm looked in the same direction.
Hundreds of meters of land between them and their previous path had collapsed, hot steam was rising from several huge cracks, and part of the golden forest had disappeared into the red mist.
"Yeah. It doesn’t exist anymore."
His friend remained silent for a moment and then added quietly after a few seconds.
"First, we need to find out how much of the path is still safe."
Lian moved toward a higher position. From there, he could see a larger part of the plain.
But the view was not very hopeful.
Several huge cracks had appeared along the paths leading to the base, and columns of steam blocked parts of their view.
Even with the ability to fly, reaching the base would take time, and considering how the cracks were continuing to spread, it was unclear which areas along their route would remain stable.
He finally landed on a relatively solid rock.
Rindo lowered his spear.
"The situation is much worse than what we saw this morning."
Lian nodded.
"Several times worse."
Then he looked toward the horizon, from far away, the huge golden wall that formed the border of the land could still be seen.
But beneath it, parts of the ground were slowly collapsing, if this continued, sooner or later, nothing would remain of this land.
Rindo took out his communication device.
"We need to report this to Alaric."
"Yeah, report our location first."
But just as Rindo was about to establish communication, something else happened.
The sound of the wind stopped.
The movement of the golden leaves stopped, and even the steam rising from the nearby cracks took on an unnatural shape for a moment.
Lian immediately raised his head.
In the sky, the huge rings of the Hollow Sun were rotating more slowly, the black pupil at their center remained still for a moment.
Then it slowly began to rotate.
Around the rock, several Withered that had been moving toward the center until then stopped.
One fell to its knees.
Another hid its head between its hands.
And a creature with long limbs began whispering in a shaking voice while looking at the sky.
He narrowed his eyes.
It’s time.
He activated [True Sequence].
In the different layers of the air, very faint lines of golden light had appeared.
The same flows he had seen before the Second Judgment.
The identification stage.
Rindo also noticed the changes and took the Ten Star Spear in his hands.
"Lian... is it time?"
"Yeah." Vorhelm stared at the black pupil for a moment.
And then, the huge, emotionless voice of the Hollow Sun spread across the entire land.
"The Third Judgment has begun."
The golden rings began rotating, the sunlight became stronger for a moment, and the black pupil, which had been moving over the central parts of the land until then, turned in another direction.
Lian followed the direction of its gaze.
The pupil moved across the cracked plains and finally stopped in the direction of the central base.
He frowned for a moment.
The base?
At that moment, his and Rindo’s communication devices activated almost at the same time, and Alaric’s voice could be heard through the static.
"Vorhelm! Rindo! Can you hear me?"
"Loud and clear, what’s happening?" Lian immediately answered.
"Report your situation first, the ground here is collapsing from several directions, where are you?"
Rindo reported their approximate location.
"We’re near the southwestern route to the center, but a large part of the way back has been destroyed."
There was silence for a few moments, and then the commander’s voice was heard again.
"The situation here has gotten much worse too, we’ve lost several positions and had to pull back the forces from the southern section."
Lian looked at the cracks around them.
"It’s the same here, the cracks have become several times larger."
Alaric paused for a moment.
"Don’t try to return through the same route for now, we need to find out which areas are still stable first."
Rindo looked at the sky.
"Commander, the Third Judgment has started."
"I know."
Alaric’s voice became weaker for a moment.
"We’ve kept the forces in the remaining positions, we still don’t know who the sun intends to—"
At that exact moment, a shout came from the communication device.
"Commander! Golden light!"
Lian fixed his gaze on the sky.
The black pupil was still pointing toward the base.
The commander’s voice was heard again.
"Damn it..."
"Commander? What happened?" Rindo tightened his grip on his spear.
For several seconds, only the sound of static could be heard, and then Alaric answered in a louder voice.
"Lian, several people here have been selected!"
"How many?" Lian narrowed his eyes, and a deep frown appeared on his face.
Alaric began to answer.
"Three... no, wait, there’s another one—"
CRAAAACK!
A terrible sound came through the communication device, and suddenly communication Disconnected
Lian looked at the communication device for a moment, Rindo immediately tried to call again, but received no answer.
Only a faint sound of static could be heard from the device.
Vorhelm slowly raised his head, far away, the golden rings of the Hollow Sun were still rotating.
And the black pupil was still staring in the same direction.
"Commander...?" Rindo whispered quietly.
Lian glanced at him but said nothing and only tightened his fingers around the communication device.
Fuck ...
